paper_title: Are Large Language Models Really Good Logical Reasoners A Comprehensive   Evaluation and Beyond
caption: Visualization on the metric of answer correctness.
model_annotation: The bar chart visualizes the performance of three large language models—Davinci-003, ChatGPT, and BARD—across two distinct tasks: Classification and Generation, as measured by the metric of answer correctness (Accuracy). The vertical axis (y-axis) represents Accuracy, scaled from 0.0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.2, while the horizontal axis (x-axis) displays the task types, with “Classification” on the left and “Generation” on the right. Each model is represented by a pair of 3D bars, one for each task, arranged side by side per task group. The bars exhibit a vertical color gradient from blue at the base to yellow at the top, likely indicating increasing accuracy or serving as a visual design element. For Classification, Davinci-003 achieves approximately 0.45 accuracy, ChatGPT around 0.15, and BARD about 0.25. For Generation, Davinci-003 scores approximately 0.8, ChatGPT around 0.65, and BARD roughly 0.55. The chart suggests that all models perform better on Generation than on Classification, with Davinci-003 consistently outperforming the others in both tasks. The bars are not sorted by height, and no additional annotations or error bars are present.
